question: Who among the following Moroccan travellers came to India during the reign of Muhammad bin Tughlaq?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Ibn Battuta__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Ibn Battuta:**​**__

 __
 
• Ibn Battuta was a Morocco Explorer and Scholar.
 
• He visited India during the reign of Muhammad bin Tuglaq.
 
• His famous literary work is Rehala__ which records magnified data about Sultanat India.**​**
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__**

**Abd-al- Razzaq**

__
 
• **Abd-al-Razzaq** was a **Persian Ambassador** who visited in the year **1443.**
 
• He visited the **Vijayanagara Empire__** in the reign of **__Devraya 2nd__** as an ambassador of **Shahrukh, The ruler of the Timurid dynasty of Persia.**

**​Al Masudi**

__
 
• **Al Masudi** visited **India in the 10th century, **he was born in **Baghdad.**
 
• He contributed to **Meteorology, Oceanography, and Islamic Laws **besides enriching **Geography **& ** History.**
 
• He traveled to the **Indus valley** and other parts of India.

**Suleiman al- Tajiri**

 
• He was an **Iranian** merchant, traveler, and writer who visited India in the **9th Century.__**
 
• He visited **Bengal **during **Pal Empire** and referred to it as **__Ruhma.__**
 
• He describes **__Mihir Bhoja **__as **__one of the mightiest rulers of the dynasty.__**

100:
